meta.title: Education for Harmony
meta.tagline: An ecosystem of interventions for self- and social-transformation.
meta.seoDescription: TIDE Foundation's Education for Harmony program builds life skills, civic responsibility, social-emotional learning, and community action.

intro.body: At TIDE Foundation we have been developing an ecosystem of educational interventions for self- and social-transformation for different contexts, age groups, and to varying degrees of depth.
aims: Promote holistic, experiential, collaborative, project-based, and human-centered learning
Build life skills like communication, problem-solving, teamwork, and leadership
Develop thinking (independent, critical, creative, and systems) and decision-making
Develop empathy, care, and compassion for others
Foster a sense of social and personal responsibility and commitment to social action
Shape a generation of socially conscious global leaders with agency for meaningful action

cares.title: Education for Harmony through Self & Social Action
cares.subtitle: EHSA is conceptualized as CARES — five interconnected dimensions of transformation.

dimensions.name: Consciousness
dimensions.desc: Seeing, awareness, and a deep understanding of social, cultural, and ecological issues — alongside understanding of their interconnectedness.

dimensions.name: Awaken Empathy
dimensions.desc: Developing a deep empathetic and caring connection with issues and the various actors impacted.

dimensions.name: Reflect & Reimagine
dimensions.desc: Deep reflection on one's own ways of living and being, underlying critical issues, and systemic nature of problems — alongside reimagining different possibilities.

dimensions.name: Engage & Empower
dimensions.desc: Act to bring about real and meaningful change while mobilising and empowering others to join in.

dimensions.name: Sense of Responsibility
dimensions.desc: Developing an intrinsic sense of responsibility that underpins behavioural change and drives larger systemic transformation.

programs.title: An ecosystem of programs
programs.subtitle: Six interconnected programs, designed for different contexts and depths of engagement.

items.name: Social Explorer Program
items.desc: Ideal for sensitization, low-stake engagement, and introduction to self and social transformation.

items.name: Social Deliberator & Planning (Model City Councils)
items.desc: Intra- and inter-school deliberative and dialogic events that support students in exploring contextual realities in their own cities and communities.

items.name: Community Changemaker
items.desc: A more action-oriented series of interventions that mobilises students to take collective action at the individual, school, peer, community, and systems level.
items.impact: 4,245 students in 154 camps across 86 schools, indirectly impacting 2,944 students

items.name: Social Ambassadors
items.desc: Selected students mobilise others in their schools and communities to act on relevant and immediate issues to create visible change.

items.name: Social Changemakers
items.desc: Students engage in longer fellowships to systemically and meaningfully resolve deeply interconnected issues.

items.name: Social Transformers
items.desc: A program for mentors that support other students, or those that engage with local governance to make a sustainable difference.

collaborate.title: Collaborate with us
collaborate.body: We are happy to share our materials and to support other organisations interested in replicating these interventions in their contexts — including regional, state, and national government, educational institutions, NGOs, and colleges offering MSW and BEd courses.
